email.subject: Anchor Fitness: quick fix idea
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

I looked at Anchor Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call button, so people searching on their phone can't tap to call you and probably just call a competitor instead. And there's no booking link, so anyone wanting to try a class has to call during hours instead of grabbing a spot at 9pm.

The site also isn't mobile-friendly and the images load slowly, which doesn't help either.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's losing you leads?

Alex
